plugins.name: godw-toolkit
plugins.description: godw atomic skill pack: godw-session-init (session contract of 11 rules), godw-goal (5Why+Mom Test clarification, two-chapter GOAL.md, finalize-once), godw-report (delivery/DELIVERY.md/status.html with impeccable detect gate) + 14 vendored skills (remotion official series/ECC/archify). Loop engine in godw-loop, search in godw-finder; install the three plugins in pairs.

description_i18n.zh-CN: One-sentence kickoff: session contract → goal finalization (5Why clarification engine) → delivery presentation (status.html per-round dashboard + impeccable gate); loop engine and search capabilities are in the godw-loop / godw-finder companion plugins.

plugins.name: data-animation-skills
plugins.description: Data animation / animated infographic skills for AI coding agents — turn a CSV into a chart that moves, with exact, accurate numbers on every frame.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 数据动画三件套：信息图序列、图表竞赛/CSV 转视频、PPT 转视频。

plugins.name: explainer-video-skills
plugins.description: Explainer video skills for AI coding agents: script, storyboard, and render narrated explainers, year-in-review recaps, and animated diagrams.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 解说视频五件套：白板、等轴测、图示动画、年度回顾、全流程解说。

plugins.name: javascript-animation-skills
plugins.description: Every frame drawn in JavaScript: canvas animation with zero image assets, rendered to MP4, with a code-synthesized Web Audio soundtrack and an A/V sync check.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 纯代码 canvas 动画与代码合成配乐（soundtrack）。

plugins.name: kinetic-typography-skills
plugins.description: Kinetic typography skills for AI coding agents — animate headlines, stagger text reveals, and build lyric/title videos across CSS, GSAP, Framer Motion, and Remotion.

plugins.name: lower-thirds-skills
plugins.description: Animated lower thirds and stream overlays with a transparent background, drawn in JavaScript and rendered to WebM with alpha (OBS) or ProRes 4444 (Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut).

description_i18n.zh-CN: 下三分之一字幕条/直播叠加层（透明 WebM/ProRes）。

plugins.name: map-animation-skills
plugins.description: Map animation skills for AI coding agents — build editorial, "Vox-style" animated maps for explainer and documentary video: camera zooms, drawn-on routes, dropped pins, region highlights, and the 12fps stutter.

plugins.name: text-message-video-skills
plugins.description: Text-message animation skills for AI coding agents — turn a chat script into a scroll-stopping iMessage/WhatsApp/SMS conversation video, rendered from a messages array.

plugins.name: tiktok-video-skills
plugins.description: TikTok, Reels, and Shorts skills for AI coding agents — engineer short-form video that survives the swipe.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 竖屏短视频三件套：字幕动画、倒计时、short-form 成片。

plugins.name: web-animation-skills
plugins.description: Web animation skills for AI coding agents — GSAP, SVG, Lottie, micro-interactions, page transitions, and 60fps performance, installed straight into your agent.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 前端网页动效九件套：GSAP、SVG、Lottie、页面转场、60fps、无障碍等，产出独立 HTML。

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design-quality gate for web/HTML deliverables: 58 offline anti-pattern rules (AI tells, contrast, type, layout) via the impeccable detect CLI, plus the impeccable skill with 24 /impeccable commands. Hooks are not installed; detection runs fully offline.

description_i18n.zh-CN: web/html 交付设计质检门禁：58 条反模式规则纯离线检测（AI 味、对比度、排版、布局），含 impeccable 技能与 detect CLI（--json 结构化输出、退出码 0/2/1）；hooks 不挂。

plugins.name: godw-loop
plugins.description: godw perpetual loop engine: three-stage main loop start (gate+analysis+proposal) -> run (FIFO dispatch+plan.md execution) -> complete (parallel postmortem/report/doc wrap-up), one-proposal-one-folder notes (3P file set: proposal/plan/postmortem), TRAP.md pitfall log, history.json decision summary ledger, self-loop workflow (godw-loop-round bundled), guard write-protection hooks (human zone / GOAL freeze / notes mechanical gate / AGENTS.md budget).

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Godw Loop：Godw自研24小时无人值守项目开发框架

description_i18n.zh-CN: Three-stage main loop start->run->complete; one-proposal-one-folder notes with 3P file set; TRAP pitfall log + history decision ledger; self-loop workflow runs zero-overlap in series; guard hooks protect human zone/GOAL/notes/AGENTS.md budgets.

plugins.name: godw-finder
plugins.description: godw unified search plugin: godw-finder orchestrator (4-agent full research, tiered adoption, reference/ disk persistence + AGENTS.md index) + atomic skills plugin-finder (offline local marketplace search), skill-finder (internet skill search and safe install), web-search (web/API channels), social-search (social platforms via browser-act). Called by godw-loop-start, also user-invocable.

displayName_i18n.zh-CN: Godw Finder: 统一搜索入口

description_i18n.zh-CN: Four-agent full research + plugin/skill/web/social four-atom search; research artifacts written to survey files + mirror + reference/AGENTS.md index.
